The '''Fenn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fenn (planet)|Fenn]] was located in the system.<ref name="CotG" />
